app.value: Life Portal reads your health data — including activity goals, time in daylight, and overnight wrist temperature — to display metrics and sync with your server.

_meta.description: NSHealthShareUsageDescription for the iPhone app target. Shown in the HealthKit read-authorization sheet. The app variant adds 'to display metrics' because the iPhone app renders the Health dashboard locally.

watch.value: Life Portal reads your health data — including activity goals, time in daylight, and overnight wrist temperature — to sync with your server.

_meta.description: NSHealthShareUsageDescription for the watchOS target. Shown in the HealthKit read-authorization sheet on the watch. The watch variant omits 'display metrics' because the watch only syncs to the server.
_meta.rationale: Intentionally distinct from permissions.health.app (D6b): the watch has no local metric display, so it omits the 'to display metrics' clause.

app.value: Life Portal needs your location to track and display your movement history.

_meta.description: NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription for the iPhone app target. Shown in the foreground-location authorization sheet. The app variant tracks and displays movement history.

watch.value: Life Portal needs your location to display your current position.

_meta.description: NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription for the watchOS target. Shown in the foreground-location authorization sheet on the watch. The watch variant only displays the current position.
_meta.rationale: Intentionally distinct from permissions.locationWhenInUse.app (D6b): the watch only shows current position rather than tracking/displaying history.

app.value: Life Portal needs continuous location access to track your movements in the background.

_meta.description: NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescription for the iPhone app target. Shown in the always-on (background) location authorization sheet. App-only: the watch target declares no always-on location usage description.

app.value: LifePortal uses motion data to detect when you arrive at and leave places, improving visit tracking accuracy.

_meta.description: NSMotionUsageDescription for the iPhone app target. Shown in the Core Motion authorization sheet; motion data refines arrival/departure detection. App-only: the watch target declares no motion usage description.
_meta.rationale: Source uses 'LifePortal' (no space) where the other permission strings use 'Life Portal'; preserved verbatim from project.yml:101 to match the live Info.plist.
